problems.title: The infinite-rank quasi-coherent extension lacks geometric PD coefficient convergence
problems.decisive_evidence: For p=3,K=Qp,E=u-p,R+=Zp<T±1>,H=completed_direct_sum R+ e_n, set phi(e_n)=-n e_n and theta(e_n)=e_(n+1) omega. The module is complete separated torsion-free; operators continuous; integrability and [phi,theta]=-theta hold. P_m(phi)e_n=(-1)^m m! binom(n,m)e_n uniformly tends to zero. But theta^m e0=e_m does not tend to zero. Forced stratification sum e_m Y^[m] has infinitely many unit coefficients modulo p and is not in the completed tensor product.
problems.impact: The advertised extra infinite-rank equivalence has an explicit object outside its essential image.
problems.repair_boundary: Remove/restrict the remark or impose precise full PD coefficient convergence with topology and descent hypotheses; finite-rank principal theorem is not refuted.
problems.counterevidence: Finite rank forces jointly nilpotent Higgs operators and restores the convergence reduction.
problems.discovery_attribution: Native local-algebra auxiliary discovered; principal mathematically evaluated and adopted after source-image inspection.

problems.title: The analytic coordinate derivative omits the factor alpha
problems.decisive_evidence: g(alpha)=chi(g)^(-1)(alpha+c(g)), with c(g)=0 in gamma direction, implies nabla_gamma alpha=-alpha, not -1. Finite-level alpha_m has zero derivative.
problems.impact: The derivative and following explanation are wrong as written.
problems.repair_boundary: Use nabla_gamma=-alpha nabla_tau on the local expansion. alpha is nonzero since tau(alpha)=alpha+1, hence is an invertible scalar and the kernels still coincide.
problems.counterevidence: The constant-kernel conclusion of Proposition7.9 is preserved.

independent_acceptance_scope.result: All six reported problems are confirmed with their stated version and scope. P3 and P5 touch important comparison statements, but the adjacent proofs, diagrams and actual constructions already use the correct normalizations; they are localized conflicts with those actual constructions. No counterexample to the correctly normalized finite-rank principal correspondence is established.
counterevidence_and_severity_basis: P1 challenges the additional infinite-rank integral interpretation of Remark4.6; the finite-rank nilpotence mechanism used by the main classification is not contradicted.
P2 is contradicted by the correct absolute face formula already printed and used.

P3 is not treated as non-core: the cohomology comparison is a principal result. Minor is supported by the actual left-side definition retaining base forms, the immediately following proof using direct E-action, and Construction4.35 using exponent -phi/a-q. The counterexample targets the inconsistent definition line, not those actual correct calculations.
P4's literal finite-set condition is false; the external Sen/decompletion result with the actual finite-span condition is not disproved.

P5's target-category wording is mathematically incompatible with the functor. Minor is supported by both existing Phi-j diagrams, the actual functor and computed Sen operator all using the positive relation; the checked comparison proof does not use the erroneous negative equation.
P6 leaves the required kernel unchanged because alpha is a nonzero field scalar, not merely because a formula can be edited.
